author: aKidWolfe96
name: KrewFantasy
short: Full Sleeper fantasy football automation and analytics for Krusty.
description: Connects a Sleeper NFL league to Discord with scoreboards, standings, matchup previews, automatic trade and waiver reports, lineup alerts, 10 weekly trophies, optimal-lineup analysis, all-play win matrix, luck index, power rankings, trophy case, recaps, playoff brackets, trending players, FAAB and season charts.
install_msg: KrewFantasy installed. Load it, then run `[p]ff setup <Sleeper league URL or ID>` and `[p]ff link @member <Sleeper team name>`. Use `[p]ff schedule` to see automatic report times.
